errorCodes.meaning: No vetter engine exists for this context and community.
A draw for this label and tick is already in flight.
The parameters name a suite the engine does not implement.
The community parameters cannot be decoded.

CommunityParameters.description: The community's hidden-vetting parameters exactly as its join manifest publishes them, under the criterion's `vetting.ext`. The caller copies them in verbatim on every call that needs them, because the community rotates labels and the engine keeps no copy of its own: a stale copy costs the caller a refused proof, never a mistaken one.
CommunityParameters.title: CommunityParameters

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

PublishedConfig.description: The parameters exactly as they now appear in this community's join manifest, under vetting.ext. What an applicant and a vetter read.

helperKey.description: The helper verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for hvk.

tokenKey.description: The token verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for tvk.

vetterLabels.description: Class labels published whole, e.g. vetter/2026-09 — a request names one of these, not the bare period.

PublishedConfig.title: PublishedConfig

PublishedEvent.description: The published shape drops approvedBy and graceDays: who approved is the community's own record, and a vetter is told closesAfter when its request is approved rather than being handed the raw grace period here.
PublishedEvent.title: PublishedEvent

Response.title: VTA PCS — Tokens — Request — response payload

TickLength.description: The length of one tick of the drip, as an ISO 8601 duration in days and/or hours — at least `PT1H`. A label's tick `t` is the window starting `t` tick lengths after the label's start (`vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-tokens`).
TickLength.title: TickLength

dripPerTick.description: How many tokens a tick under this tier yields.

name.description: How the menu names it: desk, busy-desk.

TokenDrawRequest.description: The payload of a vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-tokens/0.1 request, without its ext.

schema.description: A vetter's client asks its VTA for one draw of the attestation-token drip: blinded serials bound to the vetter's member DID, the label and the tick.

community.description: The community's DID: the helper whose parameters the engine runs under.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to. Its key is derived from this context's base.

count.description: How many tokens to ask for: normally the parameters' dripPerTick.

label.description: The token label to draw under.

parameters.description: The community's published hidden-vetting parameters, copied verbatim from its join manifest.

tick.description: The tick of the label being drawn.

schema.title: VTA PCS — Tokens — Request — payload
